selection_basis: Documented interface examples; availability and market share in Russia are not established.

pixhawk_6c.name: Holybro Pixhawk 6C
pixhawk_6c.notes: TELEM1/2 provide TX/RX/CTS/RTS. Confirm carrier revision, wiring and serial parameters; a flight controller does not echo arbitrary payload bytes.

cube_orange_plus.name: CubePilot Cube Orange+ with a compatible carrier
cube_orange_plus.notes: Verify the exact carrier pinout and configured firmware ports. Hardware flow control is an interface capability, not an automatically enabled setting.

microhard_p2400.name: Microhard P2400 serial reference
microhard_p2400.notes: Conservative 1W product-page reference; brochure mentions variant-dependent 2W. Serial interface is documented up to about 230kbps. Proprietary hopping/FEC/MAC is not equivalent to native Wi-Fi.

microhard_pmddl2450.name: Microhard pMDDL2450 Ethernet reference
microhard_pmddl2450.notes: Dual 10/100 Ethernet; vendor throughput depends on 2x2 MIMO, bandwidth and received level. The serial interface is still low rate. UDP/TCP endpoints must refer to the configured data path, not the management console. Native Wi-Fi equivalence is not established.

holybro_sik_v3_100mw.name: Holybro SiK Telemetry Radio V3 100mW serial reference
holybro_sik_v3_100mw.mac_description: SiK adaptive TDM with frequency hopping; firmware settings must be recorded.
holybro_sik_v3_100mw.notes: Documented Chinese vendor reference, not identification of the owner hardware. Single UART does not supply two physical UARTs; a compatible external controller/payload interface or multiplexing must be established. RF rate is not useful throughput. Frequency variant, firmware, hopping, error correction, framing and flow control require actual-device verification. Native Wi-Fi does not reproduce SiK PHY/MAC.
